build.notes: Human drove the build inline and directed 'then test', proceeding past the build gate (real-art drop deferred as non-blocking polish behind the manifest seam). M1-M5 + M2b done. M1 engine+content+tests; M2 playable UI; M3 Truby narrative+tapestry. M5 'finished-feeling' pass: SOUND (synth Web Audio engine audio/sound.ts — ambience loop + SFX kit + Music/SFX mixer + mute, persisted, gesture-gated, HMR-safe; wired into serve/restock/buy/beat/close); PERSISTENCE (state/store.ts: autosave + Continue + 20-run history; menu Continue/Past-seasons); FRONT-OF-HOUSE SHELL (ui/uiStore.ts + Overlays.tsx: pause [freezes night] / settings [mixer+reduce-motion] / how-to / save&quit; Esc toggles; ☰ in TopBar); ONE-OFF VIGNETTES (engine/content/vignettes.ts: 13 self-contained city scenes + storyflow fireVignette[quiet-day only, seed+day deterministic, never-repeat, day/Kiez/weekday/flag gated] + resolveVignette action; pendingVignette cleared on advanceDay so it never blocks a cast beat or the finale); ILLEGAL DARK-PATH consequence (closeNight: nightly Integrity bleed + police-raid risk[fine+Kiez/Integrity hit], security cam lowers odds → pushes greedy runs to Sold Out); SUNDAY/ORDNUNGSAMT heat surfaced in TopBar; cornerStatus() + 'Your corner' Manage panel (traffic/Kiez-per-night/community systems/flags/heat/dark-path) makes community-evolution legible; +2 CAST STRANDS (Yusuf latchkey teen→mentored/adrift; Frau Schmidt widow→watched_over/forgotten) with full 4-ending epilogue matrices → tapestry now weaves 5. 18 vitest green (added vignette fire/resolve-once + never-block tests; story tapestry 3→5), tsc clean, vite build OK (61 modules). Living BUILD-REPORT.md added. Art-independent (Gemini pixel art via ASSET-SPEC.md → manifest). M2b DONE: render/SceneStage.tsx rebuilt as a REAL PixiJS 8 scene (HD 960x540 nearest-neighbour; manifest-loaded layers via a HEAD-probe loader + procedural placeholder layers — night window/street, stocked fridge+shelves, neon SPÄTI, wood counter, per-archetype customer silhouette + want bubble; HMR-safe destroy/recreate; vite-env.d.ts added for import.meta.env; dead DOM scene CSS pruned) + dialogue PORTRAIT slots (manifest.portraitFor resolver + cast ids; PNG-or-procedural-avatar in BeatOverlay). BALANCE PASS: headless sweep exposed 2 bugs — (1) Integrity always hit 0 so EVERY ending was Sold Out, because underage restricted sales were the only Integrity sink and nothing surfaced who was underage → fixed: legalView now exposes activeUnderage/activeWantRestricted/activeIllegalSale, the autoPlayer refuses minors, and NightScreen flags '🔞 underage · ID?' + ⚠ on Sell; (2) the dark path was a pure trap (less cash AND worse ending) → retuned extra_menu trafficMult 1.15→1.4 + raid odds 14%→8% (sec 7%→4%) so it's now genuinely MORE cash (+45% in the sweep) bought with crashed Integrity → Sold Out. New tests/sim/balance.test.ts (4 assertions). 22 vitest green, tsc clean, vite build OK (Pixi bundles). Then /test (below).

test.notes: PLAYTEST ROUND 1 done inline (05-playtest-report.md). Method: full engine/sim suite (22/22 green) + a headless balance sweep across strategies + a static UX/feel review vs the GDD pillars. Verdict: mechanically sound + fun-on-paper; two real balance bugs found & fixed (integrity-always-0→always-Sold-Out; dark-path-was-a-trap). Confirmed: honest play holds Integrity 75 → Institution; dark path = +45% cash but Integrity→~30 → Sold Out; security cuts raids; Sundays = more trade (mild +EV). Open (non-blocking): real art not yet dropped (framework art-ready); Sunday mildly +EV; security net-negative cash; Kiez saturates at 100; sim ~62s. NOT yet human-played for feel (best once art lands). Awaiting human review at the TEST gate.
